decisions.reason: Existing batch QA includes five-option structure, answer/explanation checks and numerical second-check coverage. These batches show broader question construction than later factory-style production, but still require question-by-question rubric scoring and independent semantic review before live promotion.

Technical and answer QA passed, but the batches are too direct/basic in several subjects and difficulty calibration is weak. V10 also has known metadata/biology wording cleanup handled by quality_gate_v2. Questions must be rescored and weaker items rewritten before second review.

Technical QA passed but content is heavily repetitive and template-driven, difficulty distribution is 55 Kolay / 195 Orta / 0 Zor, and many questions are direct recall or one-step calculations. Full replacement/rewrite is required rather than relabeling.

rule: Batch screening is not an independent question-by-question semantic review. No item becomes liveEligible from this file alone.
